captureTokens.title: Quick capture tokens
captureTokens.description: Long-lived tokens for headless quick capture, like the iOS Action Button shortcut. A token can only create captures — it can't read, edit, or delete anything.
captureTokens.revealTitle: Copy this token now — it won't be shown again.
captureTokens.revealHint: Use it in your iOS Shortcut's Authorization header as: Bearer <token>
captureTokens.docHint: See the iOS Shortcut setup guide in the docs.

archive.title: Data & portability
archive.description: Keep a complete, human-readable copy of your Captures and restore it into any Chronicle account.
archive.exportDescription: Includes active and deleted Captures, links, external file references, transcripts, and Chronicle-managed media.
archive.exportFailed: The archive could not be created. Try again.
archive.importDescription: Import merges data into this account. Existing Captures are never overwritten; conflicts become copies.

markdown.title: Import Markdown & text
markdown.description: Add one Capture per file. YAML frontmatter can restore titles, dates, tags, aliases, source URLs, and todo state.
markdown.formatHint: Use UTF-8 .md, .markdown, or .txt (1 MiB per note), or a ZIP of up to 5,000 notes and 32 MiB. Folders only resolve links.
markdown.importConfirm: Import these files as new Captures? This is additive and will not update existing Captures.
markdown.importFailed: The files could not be imported.
markdown.analysis: Full-text search is ready. Semantic search and Related Captures are processing in the background.
markdown.replayed: This retry was already completed; the stored result is shown.
markdown.undoConfirm: Move every Capture created by this import to Trash?
markdown.undoFailed: This import could not be moved to Trash.
